articles.summary: New York, NY (February 17, 2026) – Bluerock Homes Trust, Inc. (NYSE American: BHM) (the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a new plan for the repurchase of up to $10.0 million of its outstanding shares of Class A common stock...
articles.title: Bluerock Homes Trust (BHM) Announces Share Repurchase Plan
